description:
Find troubleshooting steps for Supabase RLS, Realtime and auth callbacks, Vercel environment variables and deployment errors, or Stripe webhooks after deploy. Search published viberaven.dev guides by keyword; returns up to 5 titles, URLs and short answers. Also covers Lovable + Supabase launch checks and client handoff. No match returns an empty list.
Limits: searches the indexed published guides only; does not browse the web or read your project.

query.description: A few keywords from the question, for example "supabase tables missing rls".
